reasons: Cited §8.2/§8.3 text matches the preferred position on every parameter: successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewal terms, Customer opt-out on thirty days' written notice (≤30), a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal with the deadline tolled if the reminder is missed, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the paragraphs are returned unchanged.

The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is a false negative caused by the notice window being spelled out in words ('thirty days'', 'sixty days'') rather than digits; substance satisfies the ≤60-day (indeed ≤30-day) requirement.

The rationale correctly scopes the §2.1 three-year take-or-pay commitment as a minimum-commitment/termination-rights issue for a different rule rather than a defect in renewal mechanics, and correctly notes the Customer-only non-renewal right favours us.
